prompt: Create a website landing page for a taco food truck
summary: A single-page brochure site for "Masa Fuego," a taco food truck. The prompt asks only for a landing page — there's no user data, orders, or accounts to persist, and nothing needs to run server-side per request. A static site fully serves this: it shows the menu, hours, live location, and a call-to-action to follow on social/text for the daily spot. No web_service, postgres, or key_value is justified since there's no dynamic data lookup, no form processing that requires a backend, and nothing that outlives a single page load.
